get.summary: Read the node's XMR/USD display rate and Dew funding ratio
get.description: Public. Returns xmr_usd_cents (integer US cents per XMR), updated_at (Unix seconds), sources (the agreeing source names), and the node's fixed Dew funding ratio xmr_atomic_units per token_units (0 when unset). The node refreshes the USD rate every ten minutes from several public sources and keeps the median of at least two that agree within 10%. Without a rate newer than two hours, xmr_usd_cents and updated_at are 0 and sources is empty. The USD rate is for display only: it never sets a price, a charge or a Dew credit.

200.description: Current display rate; cacheable for five minutes
